card.name: Space before lab-value threshold numbers
card.fires_on: The space (or 'than') right after 'greater than', 'more than' or 'between' in lab-elevation thresholds, just before a multiple of the upper limit of normal. Seen with CPK, CK and ALT elevations.

modes.label: Space before multiple of ULN
modes.description: The blank token after 'greater than' and before a number like 5 or 10 times ULN for enzyme elevations.
modes.example: CPK elevation greater than<< >>5 times ULN Temporarily withhold E

modes.label: 'than' before a percentage
modes.description: The word 'than' in 'greater than' before a number in a lab finding.
